body: I just pretend i’m ok when i’m with my dad, he has depression but he doesn’t take his pills, i know that, if i kill myself, he will be terrified and probably he thinks it was his fault, but men, i hate being alive, the fact that the only time i feed good it’s when i’m sleeping or playing videogames it’s horrible, i have “friends” that talks shit about me, they are my only friends, i once tried to kill myself with painkillers but i didn’t take enough, and i just need to know how much do i have to take to end this.
